compute.scope: Calibration native replays only; historical actor/world generation and later learning compute are excluded.

hypotheses_for_learning_not_manual_edits.hypothesis: Compare every configuration field against the current scoped minimum and report only actual mismatches. Successful execution does not establish minimum compliance; overprovisioned values can still require repair.
Resolve the currently applicable scope and exception before computing discounts, then recompute dependent subtotal, tax and portfolio totals. Reconcile usage before applying overage charges.
Reserve sufficient work budget for validating the full deliverable and applying feedback before commit. Budget flags overlap substantive failures and do not identify a standalone causal explanation.

interpretation: These are descriptive development calibration observations under one fixed skill. Cells and repeats are dependent, and some cells share underlying obligations. Original online runs and new native replays are different executions. No learning improvement, causal effect, population ranking, confidence interval or precise per-case success probability is estimated.

original_selected_outcomes.note: One original online outcome per selected historical capsule; not pooled with the two new native replay outcomes.

verification.scope: Independent raw-receipt, identity, check-enumeration and aggregate reconciliation. The separate strict calibration auditor verifies the full native execution contract.

visibility: Private artifact until reviewed; all fields are allowlisted metadata, hashes or aggregates. No requests, answers, workspace files or rubric truth are included.
